bias.en: Downtrend · broke $150, on the August gap base
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $150，落在 8月缺口底部

read.en: Palantir fell 6.6% on Nov 20 to $143.49, its lowest close since Aug 3, trading $142.28–152.51 on heavy volume (1.52x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($154.2), 10-day ($162.1) and 30-day ($180.8), all falling, and the rising 100-day ($168.6) and 200-day ($154.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($172.87), and RSI is 26.4, oversold.
read.zh: Palantir 11月20日下跌 6.6%，收于 $143.49，为 8月3日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $142.28–152.51，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.52 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$154.2）、10 日（$162.1）和 30 日均线（$180.8）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 100 日（$168.6）和 200 日均线（$154.0）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$172.87），RSI 为 26.4，处于超卖区。

read.en: The drop broke the $152.6 (Nov 5 and Aug 6 lows) and $150 supports, now resistance, and the close sits on the last one, $143.3 (Aug 4 low, base of the August gap), undercut intraday. Resistance is $144.9–149.6, then $150–152.7 and $154–156.7 (200-day, 5-day). Support is $142.3–143.3, then $136–141 and $125.7 (Aug 3 close). A close above $149.6 would target $150–152.7; below $142.3, $136–141.

r.en: Round number $150, lost; Nov 20 high $152.51; Nov 5 low $152.60

s.en: Aug 4 low $143.28, base of the August gap; Aug 20, 2025 low $142.34; Nov 20 low $142.28
